svg.aria-label: LICET CSE ERP — The department ERP for Computer Science & Engineering at LICET: attendance, marks, leave, grievances and GPA under Regulations 2024. Stockfish Chess — Runs the Stockfish engine in WebAssembly workers behind a React UI, so the board stays responsive while it thinks.
